SQ_WAIT_ANY.description: Number of wave-cycles spent waiting for anything (per-simd, nondeterministic). Units in quad-cycles(4 cycles).

SQ_WAIT_INST_ANY.description: Number of wave-cycles spent waiting for any instruction issue. Units in quad-cycles(4 cycles).

SQ_INST_CYCLES_VMEM.description: The number of cycles needed to send addr and data for VMEM (lds, buffer, image, flat, scratch, global) instructions, windowed by perf_en. This value is returned on a per-SE (aggregate of values in SIMDs in the SE) basis with units in quad-cycles(4 cycles).

GRBM_EA_BUSY.description: The Efficiency Arbiter (EA) block is busy.

GL2C_EA_RDREQ_32B_sum.description: Number of 32-byte GL2C/EA read requests. Sum over GL2C instances.

GL2C_EA_RDREQ_64B_sum.description: Number of 64-byte GL2C/EA read requests. Sum over GL2C instances.

GL2C_EA_RDREQ_96B_sum.description: Number of 96-byte GL2C/EA read requests. Sum over GL2C instances.

GL2C_EA_RDREQ_128B_sum.description: Number of 128-byte GL2C/EA read requests. Sum over GL2C instances.

GL2C_MC_RDREQ.description: Number of GL2C/EA read requests (either 32-byte or 64-byte or 128-byte).

GL2C_MC_RDREQ_sum.description: Number of GL2C/EA read requests (either 32-byte or 64-byte or 128-byte). Sum over GL2C instances.

GL2C_MC_WRREQ.description: Number of transactions (either 32-byte or 64-byte) going over the GL2C_EA_wrreq interface. Atomics may travel over the same interface and are generally classified as write requests. This does not include probe commands

GL2C_MC_WRREQ_sum.description: Number of transactions (either 32-byte or 64-byte) going over the GL2C_MC_wrreq interface. Sum over GL2C instances.

GL2C_MC_WRREQ_STALL.description: Number of cycles a write request was stalled.

GL2C_EA_WRREQ_64B.description: Number of 64-byte transactions going (64-byte write or CMPSWAP) over the TC_EA_wrreq interface.

GL2C_EA_WRREQ_64B_sum.description: Number of 64-byte transactions going (64-byte write or CMPSWAP) over the GL2C_EA_wrreq interface. Sum over GL2C instances.

GL2C_HIT_sum.description: Number of cache hits. Sum over GL2C instances.

GL2C_MISS.description: Number of cache misses. UC reads count as misses.

GL2C_MISS_sum.description: Number of cache misses. Sum over GL2C instances.

GL2C_WRREQ_STALL_max.description: Number of cycles a write request was stalled. Max over GL2C instances.

FETCH_SIZE.description: The total kilobytes fetched from the video memory. This is measured with all extra fetches and any cache or memory effects taken into account.
FETCH_SIZE.interpretation: GL2C/EA fetch proxy; not a physical DRAM bus-byte measurement.

WAVE_DEP_WAIT.description: Percentage of the SQ_WAVE_CYCLE time spent waiting for anything.
WAVE_DEP_WAIT.interpretation: Broad nondeterministic wave wait; not a unique DRAM or VMEM stall cause.

limitations: Synthetic stored values, four weight-pool copies, context8256, two production shapes; not a complete model replay.
Reader families differ in load multiplicity, geometry, ordering and duration; those factors are not separated.
EA busy is not EA latency; WAVE_DEP_WAIT is not a DRAM-specific stall metric.
MALL/DRAM destination and credit-stall breakdown unavailable on installed gfx1030 catalog.
SQ instruction/VMEM counts vary despite fixed instruction work; retained as raw observations, excluded from causal inference.
